terms.comment: “The west-wind machine”, on Favōnius, the warm west wind, used as an adjective; a playful name.

phrases.latin: Ēgressum pater linteō tersit capillīsque īnstrūmentum siccātōrium admōvit.
phrases.english: When he got out, Dad dried him with a towel and held the hair dryer to his hair.
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 123, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).
Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
